title: PhonoBridge: Error-Aware Phoneme-Mediated EMG-to-Text Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electromyography (EMG) provides a non-invasive means of decoding silently articulated speech into text, but accurate decoding remains challenging due to limited availability of paired EMG-text data. We introduce PhonoBridge, a two-stage framework comprising a channel-aware EMG-to-phoneme frontend and a large language model (LLM) backend for text reconstruction. The frontend is trained on paired EMG-text data that consists of channel-wise feature extraction, cross-channel fusion, and electrode embeddings. With phonemes as the intermediate representation, we expand the backend's training data by converting LibriSpeech transcripts into phoneme-text pairs without additional EMG recordings. To adapt the LLM to frontend noise, we introduce Error-Profile-Guided Augmentation (EPGA), which perturbs transcript-derived phoneme sequences according to error patterns estimated from frontend predictions, generating additional training pairs for the L

translated_title: PhonoBridge：错误感知的基于音素介导的肌电信号到文本重建
translated_abstract: 肌电图（EMG）提供了一种无创手段，可将无声发音的语音解码为文本，但由于配对的肌电-文本数据有限，准确解码仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了PhonoBridge，这是一个两阶段框架，包含一个通道感知的肌电到音素前端和一个用于文本重建的大语言模型（LLM）后端。前端在配对的肌电-文本数据上训练，包括通道级特征提取、跨通道融合和电极嵌入。以音素作为中间表示，我们通过将LibriSpeech转录文本转换为音素-文本对来扩充后端的训练数据，而无需额外的肌电记录。为了使大语言模型适应前端噪声，我们引入了错误特征引导增强（EPGA），该方法根据从前端预测中估计的错误模式，对源自转录文本的音素序列进行扰动，为大语言模型生成额外的训练对……
tldr: 该论文提出PhonoBridge框架，以音素作为肌电信号与大语言模型之间的中间表示，并通过错误特征引导增强（EPGA）模拟前端解码错误来扩充训练数据，从而在配对肌电-文本数据稀缺的情况下实现更准确的无声语音到文本重建。
en_tdlr: PhonoBridge proposes a two-stage EMG-to-text framework that uses phonemes as an intermediate representation and employs Error-Profile-Guided Augmentation (EPGA) to expand LLM training data, enabling accurate silent speech decoding despite limited paired EMG-text data.
